observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Open-air dirt ground at night under a decorated canopy with fabric drapes and lights, with an audience seated in the background.
observation.dancers: A group of around 10-12 adult men, performing as a synchronized ensemble.
observation.formation_and_space: Initially formed in a straight horizontal line facing the audience/musicians, later spreading out into small groups, moving in circular paths and dynamic formations across the performance area.
observation.posture: Athletic and upright with slightly bent knees and weight shifting dynamically between feet.
observation.footwork: Rhythmic stepping, high knee-lifts (marching in place or while travelling), and hopping on one foot synchronized to the percussion beats.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move actively; dancers hold a small round shield in one hand and a curved sword or stick in the other, raising and brandishing them.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively stable and upright with occasional slight leans or twists during turns and lunges.
observation.partnering: None; dancers perform coordinated group choreography with occasional mock-combat gestures facing each other.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Includes high knee raises, low squatting/lunging motions, and agile turns.
observation.costume_and_props: Sleeveless patterned vests featuring a sun emblem, white pants with colored drapes/sashes, green headbands, and anklets. Holding round shields and swords/sticks as props.
observation.cannot_infer: Exact foot-to-ground contact details are obscured by darkness and low-resolution video sampling.

signature_moments.what: Dancers enter the stage running in a line while high-stepping and holding up swords and shields.
Dancers stand in a line doing rhythmic high knee lifts while brandishing swords and shields overhead.
